<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

This PR adds region-aware selection of StorageClass manifests for the GCP PD CSI driver operator. A new `getStorageClassFiles` function polls the global `Infrastructure` resource and selects between a dedicated-region-only Hyperdisk Balanced StorageClass and the regular set of StorageClass manifests based on whether the GCP region starts with `"u-"`. `RunOperator` now calls this function to determine which StorageClass assets to install instead of using a fixed list. A new `storageclass_hyperdisk_balanced.yaml` manifest is added, along with unit tests covering various region and platform status scenarios.

**Suggested reviewers:** `dobsonj`, `rhrmo`

Either shorten or remove the extra blocking wait, or update the operator’s liveness/readiness probe settings (initialDelaySeconds and failureThreshold) so the pod is not restarted while startup is still in progress. ```
